name: standing
text: Hello! I am Leo. Watch my eyes, my face, and my hands while I speak.

name: walking
text: Now I am walking and talking. My steps should feel steady and relaxed.

name: running
text: Time to run! I am picking up speed, but I can still talk to you.

name: circle
text: Around the track I go! Watch my turns, my stride, and my balance as I race.
